patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff did not apply, so the fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative 22094-fix image. That fixed build rejects the original 5225-vs-64 overlay/alpha mismatch before any downstream alpha use and only reaches downstream alpha consumption on the overlay_canvas_64 perturbation where the alpha plane width matches the image width.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: During primary-image decode, the attacker-controlled auxiliary alpha image is decoded into a separate HeifPixelImage. The witness survives parsing far enough that this nested decode succeeds and materializes the smaller alpha plane that later becomes img's Alpha channel.

Color conversion decides whether to preserve/use alpha based only on channel presence. It does not validate that input->get_width(heif_channel_Alpha) and input->get_height(heif_channel_Alpha) match the full image dimensions before the pipeline runs. The fix adds this full-resolution alpha-plane check and rejects mismatched inputs.

The conversion loop reads alpha bytes with the primary image's full width and height, even though the transferred alpha plane is smaller. This reads one byte past the alpha buffer and ASan reports a heap-buffer-overflow read at this line.
